title_en: Supreme People's Court Releases Typical Cases of Crimes Endangering Production Safety
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court Publishes Typical Cases of Crimes Endangering Production Safety

Case 1

Li Fakui, Li Chengkui, Li Xiangkui, Su Zhengxi, Su Qiangquan, Deng Kaixing — illegal trading and storage of explosives, illegal mining, major labor safety accident, failure to report safety accident, and bribery case

(Hebei Yuxian Lijiawa Coal Mine "7.14" Extraordinarily Serious Accident)

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant Li Fakui, male, Han Chinese, born on May 30, 1971, Party branch secretary of Dongzhai Village, Nanliuzhuang Town, Yuxian County, Hebei Province, shareholder of Yuxian Lijiawa Coal Mining Co., Ltd. and investor in the New Vertical Shaft of Lijiawa Coal Mine.

Defendant Li Chengkui, male, Han Chinese, born on January 28, 1963, legal representative and shareholder of Yuxian Lijiawa Coal Mining Co., Ltd., investor in the New Vertical Shaft of Lijiawa Coal Mine.

Defendant Li Xiangkui, male, Han Chinese, born on December 1, 1964, shareholder of Yuxian Lijiawa Coal Mining Co., Ltd., investor in the New Vertical Shaft of Lijiawa Coal Mine.

Defendant Su Zhengxi, male, Han Chinese, born on October 19, 1953, mine manager of Yuxian Songxi Erjing Coal Mine.

Defendant Su Qiangquan, male, Han Chinese, born on January 27, 1977, operating mine manager of the New Vertical Shaft of Lijiawa Coal Mine.

Defendant Deng Kaixing, male, Han Chinese, born on October 7, 1969, contractor team manager of the New Vertical Shaft of Lijiawa Coal Mine.

1. Facts concerning illegal trading and storage of explosives: Because the New Vertical Shaft of Lijiawa Coal Mine lacked lawful procedures, defendants Li Fakui and Li Chengkui illegally purchased explosives and detonators for production. In March or April 2008, defendant Su Zhengxi informed Li Fakui that explosives and detonators needed to be purchased. Li Fakui arranged for Su Zhengxi to contact Wei Manrong (separately prosecuted) to illegally purchase 3 tons of explosives and 3,500 detonators. Afterwards, Li Fakui and Su Zhengxi further illegally purchased 3 tons of explosives and 5,000 detonators from Liu Chengsheng (separately prosecuted). At 9:30 a.m. on July 14, 2008, explosives illegally stored underground in the New Vertical Shaft spontaneously combusted, resulting in 34 deaths and 1 missing person.

2. Facts concerning illegal mining: In November 2004, without obtaining a mining license, defendants Li Fakui, Li Chengkui, and Li Xiangkui constructed the New Vertical Shaft of Lijiawa Coal Mine on the east flank of Xixizhuang Mine Field in Baicaocun Township, Yuxian County, and engaged in unauthorized mining. During this period, when ordered by relevant government departments to cease mining, they refused to comply by means such as forging false agreements. From 2007 to 2008, defendants Su Zhengxi and Su Qiangquan served as operating mine managers of the New Vertical Shaft, and defendant Deng Kaixing served as contractor team manager during the period when his elder brother Deng Kaicai (separately prosecuted) contracted coal extraction from the New Vertical Shaft, responsible for coal extraction and safety management. According to an assessment, from June 2006, when the New Vertical Shaft began producing coal, to July 2008, it illegally mined a total of 114,600 tons of coal valued at RMB 24,001,800.

3. Facts concerning the major labor safety accident: Defendants Li Fakui, Li Chengkui, Li Xiangkui, Su Qiangquan, and Deng Kaixing, knowing that the New Vertical Shaft was a single-eye shaft and that its production safety facilities and safety conditions did not meet national requirements, still carried out production operations. At 9:30 a.m. on July 14, 2008, explosives stored underground in the shaft underwent thermal decomposition in a humid environment, resulting in spontaneous combustion. The combustion generated large quantities of toxic and hazardous substances such as carbon monoxide and nitrogen oxides, causing 34 deaths and 1 missing person, with direct economic losses of RMB 19,243,800.

4. Facts concerning failure to report the safety accident: After the above safety liability accident occurred, defendants Li Fakui, Li Chengkui, Li Xiangkui, Su Zhengxi, and Su Qiangquan failed to report it to the relevant authorities. Instead, they organized personnel to conduct blind rescue operations, causing a secondary mine disaster. To conceal the accident, they arranged for the transfer of the bodies of 28 of the deceased to a funeral home in Yangyuan County, Hebei Province for cremation, sealed the accident shaft, dismantled and removed shaft headframes and other equipment, destroyed the underground and surface accident scenes, and destroyed the New Vertical Shaft's account books and technical materials.

5. Facts concerning bribery: From 2006 to July 2008, defendants Li Fakui, Li Chengkui, and Li Xiangkui, seeking illegitimate benefits, made multiple payments of money or property to several state functionaries, totaling RMB 761,300.

(II) Judgment

The first-instance judgment of the Zhangjiakou Intermediate People's Court of Hebei Province and the review ruling of the Hebei High People's Court held that: Defendants Li Fakui, Li Chengkui, Su Zhengxi, and others illegally traded and stored explosives and detonators, causing serious consequences and serious circumstances, thus constituting the crime of illegal trading and storage of explosives. Defendants Li Fakui, Li Chengkui, Li Xiangkui, Su Zhengxi, Su Qiangquan, and Deng Kaixing violated mineral resources laws and regulations, mined without a mining license, refused to stop mining when ordered, and caused serious damage to mineral resources, thus constituting the crime of illegal mining. Defendants Li Fakui, Li Chengkui, and Li Xiangkui, knowing that the mine's production safety facilities and conditions did not meet national requirements, still organized miners to carry out underground production operations, causing a major casualty accident with particularly egregious circumstances, thus constituting the crime of major labor safety accident. Defendants Li Fakui, Li Chengkui, Li Xiangkui, Su Zhengxi, and Su Qiangquan, after the safety accident occurred, divided responsibilities and cooperated with each other to conceal the truth of the accident, delaying rescue efforts, with particularly serious circumstances, thus constituting the crime of failure to report a safety accident. Defendants Li Fakui, Li Chengkui, and Li Xiangkui, seeking illegitimate benefits, jointly or individually made multiple payments of money or property to state functionaries, thus constituting the crime of bribery. Defendant Li Fakui played a primary role in the crimes of illegal trading and storage of explosives, illegal mining, major labor safety accident, failure to report safety accident, and bribery, and shall bear primary responsibility. Defendant Li Chengkui's role in the specific implementation of the illegal trading and storage of explosives was secondary to that of Li Fakui, and a lighter punishment may be imposed according to law; he shall bear primary responsibility in the other crimes. Defendants Li Xiangkui, Su Zhengxi, Su Qiangquan, and Deng Kaixing had a lower status and played a lesser role in the crimes compared to Li Fakui and Li Chengkui. Defendant Su Qiangquan had the circumstance of voluntary surrender, and a lighter punishment was imposed according to law. In accordance with the law, defendant Li Fakui was sentenced to death with a two-year reprieve and deprivation of political rights for life for the crime of illegal trading and storage of explosives; to five years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 10,000,000 for the crime of illegal mining; to seven years' imprisonment for the crime of major labor safety accident; to five years' imprisonment for the crime of failure to report a safety accident; to two years' imprisonment for the crime of bribery; the combined sentence was death with a two-year reprieve, deprivation of political rights for life, and a fine of RMB 10,000,000. Defendant Li Chengkui was sentenced to life imprisonment and deprivation of political rights for life for the crime of illegal trading and storage of explosives; to seven years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 15,000,000 for the crime of illegal mining; to seven years' imprisonment for the crime of major labor safety accident; to five years' imprisonment for the crime of failure to report a safety accident; to three years' imprisonment for the crime of bribery; the combined sentence was life imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for life, and a fine of RMB 15,000,000. After cumulative or single punishments for multiple crimes, defendants Su Zhengxi, Li Xiangkui, Su Qiangquan, and Deng Kaixing were sentenced to, respectively, seventeen years' imprisonment, deprivation of political rights for three years, and a fine of RMB 1,000,000; six years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 5,000,000; three years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 500,000; and two years and six months' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 100,000.

Case 2

Yue Chaosheng and Xie Rongren — major liability accident case

(Heilongjiang Longmei Mining Group Xinxing Coal Mine "11.21" Extraordinarily Serious Accident)

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant Yue Chaosheng, male, Han Chinese, born on October 13, 1963, mine manager of the Xinxing Coal Mine, Hegang Branch, Heilongjiang Longmei Mining Group Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Xinxing Coal Mine").

Defendant Xie Rongren, male, Han Chinese, born on June 14, 1960, deputy mine manager of Xinxing Coal Mine.

Xinxing Coal Mine had not established a permanent surface gas extraction system, and its production safety license had expired and was temporarily withheld. From January 13 to September 18, 2009, the Heilongjiang Provincial Coal Mine Safety Supervision Bureau and its Hebin Supervision Office ordered Xinxing Coal Mine to suspend production for rectification on seven occasions, but Xinxing Coal Mine refused to comply. During construction of the exploration roadway at the 113 working face of the third level of Xinxing Coal Mine, advance drilling was not carried out in accordance with the operating procedures, and operations were conducted in violation of regulations. From September 10 to October 18, 2009, at three mine hazard identification meetings and mine management meetings, the failure to conduct advance drilling at the 113 working face of the third level was identified as a major safety hazard. On each occasion, defendant Xie Rongren (deputy mine manager), responsible for "ventilation, dust prevention, gas prevention, and fire prevention" work, was designated as the person responsible for rectification, but Xie Rongren did not carry out the rectification. Defendant Yue Chaosheng (mine manager) did not supervise its implementation, and the chief engineer Dong Qinkua (already convicted), responsible for overall technical management, and the head of the safety supervision department, Liu Zongtuan (already convicted), also did not require the responsible unit to rectify the hazard. Zhang Lijun and Wang Shou'an (both already convicted), the head and deputy head of the No. 2 Development District, continued construction operations in violation of regulations at the 113 working face of the third level. At 2:00 a.m. on November 21, 2009, a coal and gas outburst occurred during operations at the 113 working face of the third level. During on-site command, Yue Chaosheng and Xie Rongren did not order the power supply at the second level to be cut off, causing the gas that had burst from the 113 working face of the third level to enter the second level working face, where it encountered an electrical spark and exploded, resulting in 108 deaths and 133 injuries (including 6 serious injuries), with direct economic losses of RMB 56,146,500.

(II) Judgment

The judgment of the Xingshan District People's Court of Hegang, Heilongjiang Province held that defendants Yue Chaosheng and Xie Rongren violated safety management regulations during production, causing a major casualty accident, and both constituted the crime of major liability accident. Yue Chaosheng, as mine manager, repeatedly refused to comply with the production suspension and rectification orders issued by the coal mine supervision department, organized illegal production, failed to supervise the violation of regulations, and during the on-site command after the coal and gas outburst, did not order the power supply to be cut off in the second level area affected by the gas outburst, causing an extraordinarily serious accident with particularly serious consequences; he should be given a heavier punishment according to law. Xie Rongren, as the deputy mine manager responsible for "ventilation, dust prevention, gas prevention, and fire prevention" work, refused to comply with the production suspension and rectification orders issued by the coal mine supervision department and engaged in illegal production; during the illegal production, he repeatedly failed to fulfill his duties of conducting advance drilling and eliminating safety hazards; after the coal and gas outburst, during on-site command, he did not order the power supply to be cut off in the second level area affected by the gas outburst, causing an extraordinarily serious accident with particularly serious consequences; he should be given a heavier punishment. According to law, defendant Yue Chaosheng was sentenced to seven years' imprisonment for the crime of major liability accident (combined with the six months' imprisonment imposed in a separate case for the crime of illegally distributing state assets, the combined sentence was seven years' imprisonment and a fine of RMB 30,000), and defendant Xie Rongren was sentenced to seven years' imprisonment.

After the judgment was pronounced, Yue Chaosheng and Xie Rongren did not file an appeal, and the judgment became final.

Case 3

Liang Zonggang, Shao Ying, and Yang Jun — major liability accident case

(Jiangsu Nanjing Urban Express Inner Ring Project "11.26" Accident)

(I) Basic Facts

Defendant Liang Zonggang, male, Han Chinese, born on September 24, 1980, deputy executive manager of the Project Department for the South Extension Section 4 of the West Line of Nanjing Urban Express Inner Ring, China Railway 24th Bureau Group Jiangsu Engineering Co., Ltd. (hereinafter "Inner Ring Project Department").

Defendant Shao Ying, male, Han Chinese, born on October 2, 1982, chief engineer of the Inner Ring Project Department.

Defendant Yang Jun, male, Han Chinese, born on October 14, 1970, professional supervision engineer for the South Extension Section 4 of the West Line of Nanjing Urban Express Inner Ring, Nanjing Chengming Construction Consulting Co., Ltd.

In November 2010, after the steel box girders of Section 5 of the South Extension Section 4 Project Department of Nanjing Urban Express Inner Ring West Line had been hoisted into place, defendants Liang Zonggang and Shao Ying, in order to expedite the construction schedule and for construction convenience, unilaterally changed the construction procedures as designed. Without grouting and anchoring the steel box girder supports and without pouring the ballast concrete at both ends, they arranged for construction workers to carry out construction of the bridge's anti-collision walls. Defendant Yang Jun, knowing that the construction unit had unilaterally changed the construction procedures, failed to perform his supervision duties. At approximately 8:30 p.m. on November 26, 2010, while construction of the anti-collision wall on the steel box girder of span B17-B18 was underway, the steel box girder overturned and collapsed, causing the death of seven workers including Wu Cun'an who were working on the bridge surface, injuries to three workers including Lin Xianqiao working under the bridge, and direct economic losses of RMB 7,000,000. Investigation determined that the direct causes of the accident were: after the hoisting of the steel box girder for span B17-B18 was completed, the girder supports had not been grouted and bolted, so there was no effective connection between the girder body and the bridge piers; the ballast concrete had not been poured at both ends of the steel box girder, leaving the girder body in an unstable condition; when workers used vibrators to pour concrete for the outer parapet anti-collision wall on the bridge surface, adverse eccentric loads were generated, causing the entire steel box girder to lose balance and overturn. This was a production safety liability accident caused by the construction unit's violation of construction sequence and chaotic construction organization, the supervision unit's failure to diligently perform its duties, inadequate supervision by the supervisory departments, and insufficiently detailed design disclosures by the design unit.

(II) Judgment

The first-instance judgment of the Yuhuatai District People's Court of Nanjing, Jiangsu Province and the second-instance ruling of the Nanjing Intermediate People's Court held that defendants Liang Zonggang, Shao Ying, and Yang Jun violated relevant safety management regulations during the construction and supervision process, causing a major casualty accident with particularly egregious circumstances, and their actions all constituted the crime of major liability accident. Considering that the three defendants immediately rushed to the scene after the incident, carried out rescue operations, and actively cooperated with the investigation; they had the circumstance of voluntary surrender, confessed to the crimes, and expressed remorse; the accident was caused by multiple factors resulting in a single consequence, and the responsibility of each defendant was relatively dispersed; after the incident, they actively compensated the losses of the victims' family members and provided consolation, and some victims' family members issued letters of forgiveness, the court, according to law, sentenced defendant Liang Zonggang to three years' imprisonment, defendant Shao Ying to three years' imprisonment, and defendant Yang Jun to three years' imprisonment, suspended for four years, for the crime of major liability accident.
